style_read.palette_voice: Black Void (#000000) atmospheric canvas with Whiteout (#ffffff) borders and text on dark, Haze (#f5f5f5) light islands for cards and inputs, Ink (#1b1b1b) for the rare light-surface text; a desaturated steel Twilight Blue (#426188) is the only chromatic heading accent and Signal Blue (#2b7fff) is reserved for links/tags only — no filled colored CTAs, no gradients, depth comes from full-bleed photography and flat contrast, never shadow.
style_read.typographic_voice: One geometric sans (Control, subst. Inter) at a consistent weight 500 carries every text role for visual calm; poster-scale compressed uppercase display (900 weight, 259px, 0.85 leading) breaks in for hero statements, and a single cursive italic word within a headline supplies the only personality; no serifs, no decorative faces, body never below 16px or above weight 500.
signature_moves: Ghost buttons — transparent fill + 1px white border + white text, 8px radius — the only nav CTA treatment; no filled colored buttons anywhere
Full-bleed dark photographic sections (clouds, glass sculpture) with centered headline overlays, no container constraint — imagery carries the emotion
Compressed display headline at 259px/900 weight/0.85 leading, uppercase, bleeding to viewport edges, used sparingly for maximum-impact statements
Dual-style headline mixing one cursive italic word (Cursive 56px) against upright Control TNT — typographic tension that carries personality
Flat Haze cards (#f5f5f5, 12px radius, no shadow, no border) sitting as light islands on the dark canvas

selection.best_for: Developer-tool / AI-product landing pages and product launches that want a dark, atmospheric, type-driven register — full-bleed hero imagery plus restrained flat UI chrome, similar to Linear/Vercel territory.
selection.avoid_for: Content-dense enterprise dashboards, warm or playful consumer brand presentations, long-form editorial pages, or any context that needs light-mode clarity or a single strong CTA color — this system only works as dark, quiet, and image-led.

anthropic.name: Anthropic

style_read.typographic_voice: Serif (Anthropic Serif, subst. Georgia) carries the editorial voice — body at 20px and display headings at 68px weight 400 — while a sans (Anthropic Sans, subst. Inter) handles all UI chrome, nav, buttons, and a bold 61px declarative sans display; tight negative tracking (-0.02em at 12px) for UI, mono reserved only for code; underlines on links are persistent like print, never reveal-on-hover.

Filled Ivory button (#faf9f5 fill, #141413 text) as the default primary CTA, with Clay reserved for the single most consequential action per page
Persistent 1px underline on every inline link — editorial print convention, not hover-reveal
Featured hero card in manilla paper tone (#f5e3c7) at 24px radius as the editorial-importance surface without color shouting
Dark full-bleed footer (#141413) as the only inversion band in the system — a grounded anchor after all the parchment

189px ultrabold compressed display headline at 0.94 line-height — sign-painted, near-architectural scale as the page signature
Hero halftone dot pattern — orange dots on a violet-to-orange gradient, always at hero scale with 40px radius, the most recognizable motif
Filled Ember (#fc5000) pill CTA with Obsidian text, never rectangular — the sole aggressive chromatic action

Confetti color blocks — zero-radius solid rectangles (40-200px) scattered across the gray canvas as geometric information, not decoration

Cotton Candy (#ffb4ed) marker-pen highlight on key words in body copy for editorial scannability without changing text color

Marquee sheen gradient band (orange → cream → orange) across the top — the only decorative chromatic surface on the page
Single-arcade-font weight jump (400 body → 700 titles/nav/footer) as the complete hierarchy system

Full-bleed hand-painted atmospheric illustrations (moonlit skylines, wildflower meadows) as the emotional work, with UI living on clean white between scenes
Border-only CTA in Signal Blue (#41a1cf) at 8px radius — no fill, no shadow, the chromatic border is the button's entire identity
Green-tinted 1px Mist (#dee2de) hairline borders on cards — the signature edge treatment that harmonizes with the illustrations
Cerulean (#0081c0) saturated card surface as a lone punctuation moment of color intensity

signature_moves: 288px / weight 300 / line-height 0.80 / -0.03em tracking display headline — the brand name rendered as a locked wall of ink, size IS the identity
Full-bleed mint-to-black band alternation producing poster-strip rhythm rather than card-based hierarchy
Fully pill-shaped 140px controls for every interactive element — no squared or rounded-rect variants, hover inverts fill (mint→black, black→mint)
Black showcase band spanning viewport width with 288px dingbat glyphs in Pledge Mint — the product proven at use size, the only color-on-black moment
1px solid black borders + 14px soft card radius — components feel stamped rather than designed

henry.name: Henry

Inter) carries all UI at 12-24px with hairline-tight -0.01em tracking — no serif below 32px on long passages, no tracking looser than 1.5 line-height on body.

Manuka section mastheads at 226-371px, weight 400, line-height 0.75, uppercase, edge-to-edge — condensed type as the entire section identity
Louize Display headline at 116-132px with an intersecting half-size italic phrase set inside the same baseline (e.g. 'of the' at 35px within 132px type)
Square-cornered monochrome halftone plate as a typographic counterweight to the display headline — no radius, no caption, no color
Brand ticker strip — repeated Louize Display wordmarks on a dark Ink band with 'COMING SOON' ghost tags (12px radius, 1px outline)

selection.avoid_for: SaaS product marketing, e-commerce, dashboards, or any context needing imagery, product art, or a single CTA color — with no chromatic accent, no filled CTAs, and no shadows, the system can only carry type-first editorial content.

All-caps bullet/step-number micro-labels ('• STEP 1: THE BRIEF') in 12px Nng as the primary wayfinding device
Burnt-amber border + honey-gold text on tag pills — the only warm highlight pair, reserved for emphasis
1px hairline borders instead of box-shadows — the system is flat by design, elevation via color contrast

3D drop-shadow headlines — a solid #ff4100 offset on #ffc700 text, no blur, built-in dimensional depth
Sun-yellow starburst product badges instead of rectangular cards — no shadows, just geometric sun shapes
Zigzag SVGs, pointing hands, and royal-blue outlined links as decorative punctuation; 0px radius everywhere

selection.avoid_for: Data-dense SaaS dashboards, consumer retail, formal corporate sites, or any context needing quiet restraint or multi-color illustration — the full-bleed cobalt-and-ice split, single-weight 400 type, and emoji-marble texture are a bold declarative voice that overwhelms informational density.

superr.name: Superr

style_read.palette_voice: A warm cream-paper canvas (#fdfbf9) with a slightly warmer Dew Drop tint (#f7efe9) replaces pure white entirely; Charcoal (#171717) is the only ink — borders, button strokes, and structural edges; Cocoa Ink (#2b1a07) warms up headlines like notebook leather; a single Marker Orange (#ff6f1e) is the accent for handwritten captions, marker highlights, and the footer brand band; Sky/Bubblegum/Sprout sticker hues are decoration only, never functional UI; shadows stay whisper-light.
style_read.typographic_voice: One custom rounded soft sans (gelica, subst. Recoleta/Fraunces/DM Serif Display) carries all display, heading, and body text — lowercase is the default, speaking quietly through size and weight (400/500/600) with normal letter-spacing; Geist (subst. Inter/Söhne) appears sparingly for nav and fine-print captions to cut the warmth; never capitalize headlines, never apply letter-spacing, and never let Geist own display sizes.
signature_moves: The 104px lowercase gelica weight-600 display headline at line-height 1.08 — a tactile object rather than a title, always left-aligned and never center-aligned after the first line
Handwritten Marker Orange captions (gelica 20–24px, weight 400) paired with thin hand-drawn Charcoal SVG arrows pointing at the photographed product object
Photographed leather-bound notebooks as the hero product asset, tilted 5–8° off-axis with a white name-label sticker (Name / Class / Roll no.) on the cover
Flat sticker illustrations (lightning, bear, heart, ghost) with 2px dark outlines placed at random 5–15° rotations — treated as physical peel-and-stick, never grid-aligned
The outlined pill button — cream fill with a 1.5px Charcoal border, no fill state; the identity is the dark border, not the background

selection.best_for: Consumer product launches and playful D2C brands (notebooks, stationery, lifestyle goods) that want a warm schoolyard feel — cream-paper canvas, hand-marker orange annotations, photographed product objects, chunky lowercase display type, and sticker illustrations scattered like physical peel-and-stick.
selection.avoid_for: Enterprise SaaS dashboards, dark-mode products, formal corporate reports, or any context needing neutral data-density or a screen-white canvas — the cream-paper, marker-orange, sticker-and-notebook vocabulary is a warm, tactile, slightly mischievous register that fights neutral professionalism.

syllabus.name: Syllabus

style_read.palette_voice: A warm cream paper (#fffcf7) is the canvas and default card surface — never pure white; Ink Violet (#0d0129) is the near-black structural color for text, 1px outlines, and the solid nav CTA; Butter Yellow (#fae59b) is the single raised voice, reserved for the hard-shadow in-page CTA and small decorative dots, never as a large wash; Deep Teal (#19615c) provides full-bleed dark section bands; Shadow Black exists only as the 1–3px offset shadow behind yellow buttons and line-art fills. No gradients, no soft shadows.
style_read.typographic_voice: One custom geometric sans (Roobert, subst. Inter/Söhne/General Sans) is the sole typeface — weight 700 for display headlines and button labels, weight 400 for body, nav, and subheadings; hierarchy is carried by wide 16–64px scale jumps with normal tracking rather than letter-spacing or intermediate weights; a mono-adjacent Supply (subst. JetBrains Mono) is a sparing 20px accent for illustration-adjacent paragraphs; no serif, no additional families, no sizes outside the narrow scale.
signature_moves: The Butter Yellow CTA with a hard-offset black shadow (1px 1px 3px #000000) and 1px Ink Violet border — every action becomes a physical, pressable sticker against the cream
Sharp 0px corners everywhere — buttons, cards, tags, and inputs are all square; the only shadow in the system is the hard yellow-button offset
The strict Roobert 700/400 weight pair at wide size jumps (16→20→24→40→48→56→64px) — hierarchy comes from scale jumps, never interpolated sizes or tracking
1px Ink Violet borders outline cream/white cards and illustration containers like a print frame — the primary structural device
Flat line-art illustrations with selective yellow/teal fills that break past container edges in an 'isometric explosion' pattern — schematic wireframes, never photography

selection.best_for: Editorial-tech product landing pages (premium SaaS, waitlists, developer-adjacent launches) that want a print-magazine feel — warm cream paper canvas, near-black violet ink, oversized geometric headlines, sharp 0px corners, one buttery-yellow hard-shadow CTA, and flat line-art illustrations.
selection.avoid_for: Dark-mode products, dense operational dashboards, consumer retail with heavy photography, or any context needing soft rounded corners or screen-white purity — the sharp-cornered 0px-radius geometry, cream canvas, and hard-offset sticker CTA are a distinctive premium print-magazine voice that resists neutral SaaS conventions.

source.radius: 0px everywhere (tags, cards, inputs, buttons) — sharp-cornered system
source.shadow: single hard offset on yellow CTA only: rgb(0,0,0) 1px 1px 3px 0px

syllabus.tagline: cream-paper magazine meets geometric sans-serif. Warm off-white surfaces, near-black violet ink, and one buttery yellow accent that functions as the page's only raised voice — like a sticky note pressed onto fine stationery.

ventriloc.name: Ventriloc

style_read.palette_voice: A warm paper-white canvas (#ffffff) with warm-gray surfaces (Ash #efefef, Fog #f5f5f5, Ivory #ebe6dd) — warm grays and ivory instead of cool tech-blue; Graphite (#202020) anchors all text and the dark filled CTA; a single Ember Orange (#ff682c) punctuates the monochrome like a highlighter on a printed report — used only for link underlines, chart highlights, and small icon accents, never as a CTA fill; Brass (#816729) adds a muted warm counterpoint for chart strokes and tags. Pages stay 95% achromatic.
style_read.typographic_voice: A two-face system where PolySans (subst. Inter Tight/Space Grotesk) is the voice and Inter is the grammar: PolySans at weight 400 only (never 500/600) with -0.02em tracking across headings, nav items, and button labels, with the 66px display at 0.91 leading; Inter handles all body copy, captions, and metadata at 400–600; line-height never exceeds 1.25 on display headings; the tight letter-spacing compensates for the light weight at large sizes, keeping headlines precise and architectural.
signature_moves: The asymmetric border-radius 6px 0px 0px on featured cards — a single cut corner that signals editorial layout instead of a standard card grid, paired with 0px-radius buttons and 200px-radius nav pills (a three-radius system: sharp → asymmetric → fully round)
PolySans at weight 400 with -0.02em tracking for every heading, nav item, and button label — whisper-weight editorial authority that no bold headline could replicate
The 66px display headline at line-height 0.91 with -1.32px tracking — a tight, poster-like typographic statement on white canvas
Dark Graphite-filled sharp-cornered CTA button (0px radius) contrasted against the soft rounded card system

Data dashboard cards (line charts, stat rings, revenue widgets) in Ember Orange and Brass strokes floating on warm-gray surfaces — the charts ARE the imagery, no shadows, alternating white/ash bands instead of dividers

selection.best_for: Data-product and analytics SaaS landing pages (observability, finance dashboards, B2B data platforms) that want an editorial observatory feel — warm paper-white canvas, monospaced-precision data cards, a single orange ember as highlight, weight-400 PolySans headlines, and chart widgets as the imagery.
selection.avoid_for: Consumer retail, playful multi-color brands, loud startup launches, or any context needing bold or emotional typography — the whisper-weight PolySans, 95% achromatic restraint, asymmetric cut-corner cards, and generous whitespace are a quiet editorial voice that reads like a printed annual report, not a hype page.

ventriloc.tagline: Editorial data observatory on warm paper — a single orange ember punctuating monochrome precision.

style_read.palette_voice: A disciplined four-color palette: warm Lumen Cream (#ffffeb) as the dominant canvas and light text, Vast Ink (#1a1a1a) as the near-black dark chambers and 2px borders, Lavender Whisper (#f0d7ff) for the primary CTA and accent surfaces, and Forest Ink (#034f46) teal for badges and secondary buttons on dark; Ember Glow orange (#ffa946) punctuates only active/live states. No gradients, no drop shadows — flat fills, 2px ink borders, and fill alternation (cream → dark → cream) do all the separation.
style_read.typographic_voice: A two-face system: EB Garamond (subst. Cormorant Garamond/Playfair) is the classical serif at weight 400 only, used at massive display sizes (32–120px) where scale commands and 0.85–0.95 line-height tightens lines into a single horizontal gesture; Figtree (subst. Inter/Plus Jakarta Sans/Manrope) is the geometric sans for all body, nav, buttons, and badges at weight 400 default with 500–700 for emphasis and a steady 1.3 line-height; never bold the serif display, never center body text, never use border-radius below 12px on buttons or 32px on cards.
signature_moves: Cream and dark 'velvet chamber' sections alternating page-wide, each dark chamber bookended by cream, with oversized 40–80px border radii that make sections feel like rounded inset pebbles rather than elevated overlays
EB Garamond weight-400 display serif at 48–120px with 0.85–0.95 line-height — authority through sheer scale and tight leading, never bold; negative tracking (-3.6px at 120px)
The 2px solid Vast Ink border on every interactive element — the thick border is the signature, non-negotiable on the lavender CTA
Lavender Whisper (#f0d7ff) as the sole primary action color, echoed by hand-drawn lavender SVG squiggle underlines beneath 1–2 words in headlines to link emphasis and action

The waveform visualizer pill — cream pill with 2px ink border and 5–7 pulsing vertical bars — doubling as audio indicator and decorative rhythm marker; plus flat phone mockups and curved text arcs as the only graphics

selection.best_for: AI / productivity / speech-to-text software landing pages (dictation, writing tools, typing apps) that want an editorial broadsheet feel — cream and dark-velvet chambers, weight-400 EB Garamond display at 48–120px, oversized rounded corners, a soft lavender CTA, and waveform visualizers as signature graphics.
selection.avoid_for: Dense operational dashboards, formal corporate sites, consumer retail with heavy photography, or any context needing sharp corners or screen-pure white — the cream broadsheet, 2px ink borders, oversized rounded chambers, and lavender CTA are a warm editorial voice that reads like a printed magazine rebuilt for software, not a neutral B2B page.
